textNodes.text: Violet Magazine wanted issue 12 to feel collectable. The theme was letters, so the type had to do the work the photos usually do.
textNodes.fontFamily: "Mona Sans Variable", "Mona Sans Variable Placeholder", sans-serif

textNodes.text: I art-directed the issue and a series of posters that came folded inside, each one built from a single letter of the alphabet.
textNodes.fontFamily: "Mona Sans Variable", "Mona Sans Variable Placeholder", sans-serif
"Mona Sans Variable", "Mona Sans Variable Placeholder", sans-serif
"Mona Sans Variable", "Mona Sans Variable Placeholder", sans-serif

textNodes.text: Picked one typeface family and pushed it from hairline to black
textNodes.fontFamily: "Mona Sans Variable", "Mona Sans Variable Placeholder", sans-serif

textNodes.text: Set a grid that lets every spread break it once, on purpose
textNodes.fontFamily: "Mona Sans Variable", "Mona Sans Variable Placeholder", sans-serif

textNodes.text: Designed six fold-out posters that join into one word on a wall
textNodes.fontFamily: "Mona Sans Variable", "Mona Sans Variable Placeholder", sans-serif

textNodes.text: Worked with the printer on a fluorescent fifth colour for the covers
textNodes.fontFamily: "Mona Sans Variable", "Mona Sans Variable Placeholder", sans-serif

textNodes.text: Built a small web gallery so readers could see all six posters together
textNodes.fontFamily: "Mona Sans Variable", "Mona Sans Variable Placeholder", sans-serif
"Mona Sans Variable", "Mona Sans Variable Placeholder", sans-serif
"Mona Sans Variable", "Mona Sans Variable Placeholder", sans-serif

textNodes.text: Same hands on both sides. The frame on the left is the design file, the panel on the right is what shipped — type, spacing and colour come straight across.
